title: Lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M50 10 C50 10 35 10 35 25' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 10 C50 10 65 10 65 25' fill='none' stroke='#b06a2a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='36' y='23' width='28' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e8a13a'/>
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f5c063'/>
  <!-- glow halo -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- lantern body -->
  <rect x='30' y='31' width='40' height='40' rx='6' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- inner light -->
  <rect x='36' y='37' width='28' height='28' rx='4' fill='#fff4b0'/>
  <!-- flame -->
  <path d='M50 44 C46 50 46 56 50 58 C54 56 54 50 50 44 Z' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <path d='M50 49 C48 52 48 55 50 56 C52 55 52 52 50 49 Z' fill='#fff8d0'/>
  <!-- vertical frame bars -->
  <rect x='29' y='31' width='3' height='40' rx='1' fill='#b06a2a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='31' width='3' height='40' rx='1' fill='#b06a2a'/>
  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='36' y='69' width='28' height='8' rx='3' fill='#e8a13a'/>
  <rect x='32' y='71' width='36' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f5c063'/>
  <!-- base -->
  <rect x='38' y='77' width='24' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b06a2a'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <rect x='40' y='82' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8f4e1e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='82' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8f4e1e'/>
  <!-- shine highlights -->
  <rect x='38' y='38' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.55'/>
</svg>
